description.value: Smile Chicken is a Korean fast-casual restaurant in downtown Victoria specializing in Korean-style fried chicken and corndogs alongside sides like kimchi and pickled radish. Located in a unit at 1001 Douglas St, it offers online ordering with a 15-minute pickup window, making it a quick stop for cyclists passing through the city centre. With 53 customer reviews, it has established a following for its corndog and seasoned chicken offerings.
